scholarships.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at Carnegie Mellon University Africa

eligibility: Admitted to one of CMU-Africa's degree programmes (MSIT, MS ECE or MS EAI); admission to CMU-Africa is a prerequisite for consideration
Faces social and economic barriers to opportunity
Demonstrated academic talent and the drive to complete their education
Demonstrated commitment to giving back and improving their communities
Potential to lead, as future role models, mentors and change-makers
Eligible nationality for CMU-Africa need-based aid; only admitted applicants of African nationality are eligible for CMU-Africa financial aid
existing.eligibility_summary: Admitted students in one of CMU-Africa's Master of Science programmes who face social and economic barriers to opportunity and demonstrate academic talent, commitment to giving back and potential to lead. CMU-Africa states that students must first be admitted to one of its degree programmes to be considered for the Programme.
benefits: Full tuition and fees (2026-2027 tuition for African students at CMU-Africa is USD 16,000)
Laptop, textbooks, technology fee, campus shuttle service and student life activities
coverage: Full tuition and fees (2026-2027 tuition for African students at CMU-Africa is USD 16,000)
Laptop, textbooks, technology fee, campus shuttle service and student life activities
requirements: Submit an online application to the MSIT, MS ECE or MS EAI programme
Complete the competency tests required by CMU-Africa
Submit valid English proficiency scores (DET, IELTS or TOEFL)
Complete the separate financial aid assessment form after submitting the admission application
Meet the deadline for the admission round
documents: Online application to the relevant CMU-Africa Master of Science programme
Valid DET, IELTS or TOEFL English proficiency score by the applicable deadline
Completed CMU-Africa financial aid assessment form
existing.english_requirement: Valid DET, IELTS or TOEFL scores are required; any application received after the early admission deadline will only be considered if submitted with valid DET/IELTS/TOEFL.
application_method: Apply online through the CMU graduate admissions application portal
Submit the separate financial aid assessment form once the admission application has been submitted
Request consideration for the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Programme after admission
existing.selection_notes: CMU-Africa states the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Programme was established in 2016 and is part of a global network of 33 Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program partners. The Class of 2026 includes 57 Mastercard Foundation Scholars, and 40 graduated as members of the Class of 2025. Scholars come from 22 nationalities, 40 percent are from Rwanda, and 45 percent are female.
existing.best_fit: Admitted CMU-Africa Master's students from across Africa who face significant social and economic barriers, have strong academic records and a demonstrated commitment to community development and leadership.
existing.notes: CMU-Africa's 2026-2027 estimated cost of attendance is USD 16,000 tuition for African students and USD 61,510 for international students, plus estimated monthly living expenses of USD 345 to USD 580. The Programme is one of several need-based funding routes at CMU-Africa, alongside the Government of Rwanda grant and loan programmes and several named fellowships.
existing.duration: Master of Science degree at CMU-Africa in Kigali, with the semester beginning in September.
existing.application_period: Annual cycle: applications open October 1, early admission deadline December 15, final application deadline January 15. Applications are reviewed January to April and decisions are shared April to May.
existing.deadline_display: October 1: All program applications open. December 15: Early admission deadline - submit your application by the early admission deadline of December 15 for CMU-Africa to cover your competency test fees. January 15: Final application deadline - any application received after the early admission deadline will only be considered if submitted with valid DET/IELTS/TOEFL.
existing.program_type: Fully funded need-based graduate scholarship partnership between Carnegie Mellon University Africa and the Mastercard Foundation.
